en.why: The preview on each screen is the next screen itself, so content sharpens as the camera moves in and the viewer sees one product going deeper with no cut. Every dive starts from a click, with the cursor press and the start of the move on the same frame, so cause and effect are clear. The first and last frames are identical, so the film loops.
spec: Film 10s (300 frames), four levels. Level 1 takes 2.2s: slow push-in 0–0.9s (27 frames, scale 1.00 to 1.02), cursor glide 0.15–0.8s, accent ring on the card 0.78–0.9s, click at 0.9s, dive 0.9–2.2s (1.3s, 39 frames). Levels 2–4 take 1.95s each, starting at 2.2, 4.15 and 6.1s, with a shorter 0.65s push-in (scale 1.00 to 1.02), a 0.45s cursor glide from the start of the level, clicks at 2.85, 4.8 and 6.75s and 1.3s dives. The dives end at 2.2, 4.15, 6.1 and 8.05s, the cursor returns 8.05–8.9s and rests until 10s, and the last frame matches the first pixel for pixel

Push-in sine.inOut; dive cubic-bezier(0.45,0,0.12,1) applied to the logarithm of the scale, so each doubling of scale takes the same eased time and the zoom looks even at every scale; blur is measured on screen and rises to 1px 0.04–0.94s after the click (peak about 0.49s) and returns to 0, with the blur on the scaled layer divided by the current scale so the incoming preview stays readable; the card's corner radius drops to 0 over 0.5s starting 0.6s after the click; cursor power2.inOut (0.65s on level 1, 0.45s on the others), press to 0.86 scale in 0.08s, release back.out(1.7) 0.25s, and a click ripple (a 2px #0f9d6e ring at the click point, scale 0.3 to 1.6 and opacity 0.75 to 0 over 0.5s, power2.out); the cursor then fades out over 0.22s starting 0.08s after the click and fade back in over 0.15s at the start of the next level

Flat 2D, no tilt. The slow push-in pivots about a point left of the card (x 720 to 800, y 400) so the sidebar icons and labels stay in frame at the click. A fixed-point zoom takes the card rectangle to the full frame, at 3.75x, 3.33x, 5.03x and 4.0x, about 251x in total. On the frame where each dive ends, a fresh copy of the next screen at 1x scale takes over with identical pixels, so the scale never exceeds 5.03x

Four 1920x1080 product screens, each holding a preview of the next: a projects grid (9 cards, 512x288 covers), a project overview (4 stat tiles, burndown chart, 5 milestones, two view cards with 576x324 covers), a kanban board (4 columns, 24 cards, a 382x215 cover on ATL-214) and an issue page (properties panel, 2 comments, a 480x270 embedded view of the projects grid). Each screen nests four deeper previews

The cursor press, the ring fading and the start of the dive share one frame (0.9, 2.85, 4.8 and 6.75s) and the cursor fades out right after; when the dive ends the corner radius is 0, the preview fills the frame exactly, and the next screen's fresh copy takes over on that same frame while the cursor fades back in and starts its next glide
Light UI with one accent, #0f9d6e (primary button, selection ring, charts); Inter 14px UI text with real English content (Maya Chen, ATL-214, Nov 26); pastel label chips; 5% vignette at the edges

Make four full-screen product screens: a projects grid (9 cards, 512x288 covers), a project overview (4 stat tiles, burndown chart, 5 milestones, two view cards with 576x324 covers), a kanban board (4 columns, 24 cards, a 382x215 cover on ATL-214) and an issue page (properties panel, 2 comments, an embedded 480x270 view of the projects grid). On each screen one card's cover is the complete next screen scaled down, the embedded view on the last screen is the first screen, and each screen nests four deeper previews. Run four levels starting at 0, 2.2, 4.15 and 6.1s: a slow push-in from 1.00 to 1.02 (sine.inOut, pivoting about a point left of the card at x 720 to 800 and y 400 so the sidebar stays in frame) lasting 0.9s on level 1 and 0.65s on the other three, the cursor gliding to the card before the click (0.15–0.8s on level 1, 0.45s from the start of the level on the others), a 3px accent ring on the card 0.12s before the click, a 2px accent click ripple growing from scale 0.3 to 1.6 and fading from 0.75 to 0 over 0.5s (power2.out), and the click at 0.9, 2.85, 4.8 and 6.75s with the dive starting on that same frame. Each dive takes 1.3s as a fixed-point zoom from the card rectangle to the full frame (3.75x, 3.33x, 5.03x and 4.0x), with cubic-bezier(0.45,0,0.12,1) applied to the logarithm of the scale, on-screen blur rising to 1px and back to 0 (divide the blur on the scaled layer by the current scale so the incoming preview stays readable), and the card's corner radius dropping to 0 near the end. Fade the cursor out over 0.22s starting 0.08s after the click and fade it back in over 0.15s at the start of the next level. On the frame where each dive ends, swap in a fresh copy of the next screen at 1x scale so the scale never exceeds 5.03x. From 8.05 to 8.9s the cursor returns to its start position and rests until 10s; the last frame matches the first pixel for pixel so the film loops. Use HTML + GSAP with no bitmaps.

body.h2: How to make a Infinite Zoom Effect with Claude Code or Codex
body.body:
Build four 1920x1080 product screens where one card's cover is the next screen scaled down: a projects grid with a 512x288 cover, a project overview with a 576x324 view card, a kanban board with a 382x215 cover and an issue page with a 480x270 embedded view of the first screen. Nest four deeper previews inside each screen so the detail is already there when the camera arrives.

Zoom each card rectangle to the full frame with a fixed-point zoom, at 3.75x, 3.33x, 5.03x and 4.0x. A dive takes 1.3s with cubic-bezier(0.45,0,0.12,1) applied to the logarithm of the scale, so each doubling of scale takes the same eased time and the zoom looks even at every scale. Start it on the cursor click, after a slow push from 1.00 to 1.02 that lasts 0.9s on level 1 and 0.65s on the other three. On-screen blur peaks at 1px and the card's corner radius drops to 0 at the end. The cursor fades out as the dive starts. Swap in a fresh copy of the next screen on the last frame of each dive so the scale never exceeds 5.03x.

Level 1 takes 2.2s and levels 2–4 take 1.95s each, so the fourth dive ends at 8.05s. The cursor returns to its start from 8.05s to 8.9s and the film rests until 10s, with the last frame identical to the first. Press the copy button to send the recipe to Claude Code or Codex, or install the skill once with npx skills add krisyangdev/motionboard. Render an MP4 with HyperFrames, or port the GSAP timeline to your site.

en.alt: A project dashboard with a burndown chart and milestones, its board preview outlined in green as the next zoom target.
faq: What is an infinite zoom effect?

An infinite zoom keeps moving the camera into the content, and each new frame contains the next level inside the current one. In a product film the camera dives through nested screens: a project, its board, one issue, and so on. Here each dive takes 1.3s, four levels in all.
How do I make an infinite zoom loop?

Make the deepest screen contain the first screen as a preview, so the last frame matches the first. Nest a few levels of previews inside each screen so detail is there during the dive, and swap in a fresh copy of the next screen at the end of each dive to keep the scale small.
Is the Infinite UI Zoom recipe free to use?

Yes. Motionboard is free and MIT licensed, so you can use and modify the recipes and the films they produce in personal and commercial projects. The licence asks only that copies of the recipe files keep the copyright notice.

body.h2: 用 Claude Code 或 Codex 做无限缩放效果
body.body:
做四个 1920×1080 的产品界面，每一屏有一张卡片，封面是缩小的下一屏：项目列表（封面 512×288）、项目概览（视图卡片 576×324）、看板（封面 382×215）、任务页（内嵌 480×270 的第一屏视图）。每一屏里再嵌套四层预览，镜头到达时细节已经在了。

以每张卡片的矩形为目标做定点缩放，倍率依次为 3.75×、3.33×、5.03×、4.0×。一次推进 1.3 秒，用 cubic-bezier(0.45,0,0.12,1) 作用在缩放比例的对数上，缩放每翻一倍用同样的缓动时间，放大在各个倍数上看起来均匀。推进从光标点击开始，点击前先慢推，缩放从 1.00 到 1.02，第 1 层 0.9 秒，后三层 0.65 秒。屏幕上的模糊最高 1px，卡片圆角在结尾降到 0，光标在推进开始时淡出。每次推进的最后一帧换成下一屏的新副本，缩放倍率始终不超过 5.03×。

第 1 层 2.2 秒，第 2–4 层各 1.95 秒，第四次推进在 8.05 秒结束。光标在 8.05–8.9 秒回到起点，静止到 10 秒，末帧与首帧相同。点击复制按钮，把配方发给 Claude Code 或 Codex，也可以用 npx skills add krisyangdev/motionboard 安装技能。可以用 HyperFrames 渲染成 MP4，也可以把 GSAP 时间线移植到网站上。

faq: 无限缩放让镜头不断钻进内容，每个画面里都包含下一层。产品片里常见的做法是钻进一层层嵌套的界面：项目、看板、某一条任务，依此类推。这支片子每次推进 1.3 秒，共四层。
怎样做出可以循环的无限缩放？
让最深的一屏把第一屏作为预览放进自己里面，这样末帧和首帧相同。每一屏里嵌套几层预览，推进时细节才是现成的；每次推进结束时换成下一屏的新副本，缩放倍率就不会越来越大。
可以。Motionboard 免费，使用 MIT 许可证，你可以在个人和商业项目里使用、修改配方和它生成的视频。许可证只要求复制配方文件时保留版权声明。
